messages.author: dd4b3d6d96fbed2d
messages.subject: Linear Regression Coefficients
parts:
Hi,

New user here. . .

I've built a linear regression model where I wish to see certain
variables interacting (var1*var2), but the individual variables by
themselves var1, var2 are not in the model. After running the model,
I see coefficients for each of the variables individually in addition
to coefficients for the interacting variables. What is the meaning of
the coefficients of individual variables if they are not in the model
except where they are part of an interacting variable?

In the results, would I use the coeffiecients for variables in the
model only and ignore the rest?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Linear Regression Coefficients
parts:
the * operator includes all lower level interactions. you are looking for :

Example:
lm(formula=mpg ~ cyl:hp,data=mtcars,na.action=na.omit)
